```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.2)
```

mhspcarpi scores patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer (mHSPC) on a risk model developed from individual participant data of 4 placebo-controlled randomized clinical trials of androgen receptor pathway inhibitors (ARPIs). For each patient it returns:

- the risk of death within 4 years with placebo plus androgen deprivation therapy (ADT), called baseline risk; and
- the pooled treatment effects of an ARPI plus ADT versus placebo plus ADT at that baseline risk, each with a 95% confidence interval and a 95% prediction interval.

```{r}
library(mhspcarpi)
```

## Inputs

`model_inputs()` lists the 9 inputs, the column names expected in a data frame, the units, and what to enter.

```{r}
inputs <- model_inputs()
inputs[c("name", "unit", "accepted", "scoring")]
```

The package includes 6 synthetic patients that span the range of baseline risk.

```{r}
example_patients
```

## Baseline risk

`predict_baseline_risk()` returns one row per patient. The `notes` column reports values outside the range observed in the trials and baseline risks outside the range in which treatment effects were estimated.

```{r}
risk <- predict_baseline_risk(example_patients)
risk
```

## Treatment effects

`estimate_treatment_effect()` returns the effects at each patient's baseline risk in long format. The `ard` scale is the difference in the probability of being alive at 4 years, `rmst` is the difference in restricted mean survival time through 4 years in months, and `hr` is the hazard ratio for death.

```{r}
effects <- estimate_treatment_effect(example_patients, scale = c("ard", "rmst"))
effects[c("row", "baseline_risk", "scale", "estimate", "conf_low", "conf_high")]
```

Patients whose baseline risk falls outside the 1st to 99th percentiles of the trials receive the effect at the nearest edge of that range, with `in_effect_range` set to `FALSE`.

## Checking data before scoring

`check_inputs()` stops with an informative error when a value is missing or impossible, and returns warnings and notes for values outside the trial range.

```{r, error = TRUE}
check_inputs(data.frame(example_patients[1, ], hemoglobin = -1))
```

## Plotting

`plot_treatment_effect()` draws the pooled effect across baseline risk, with the patients in `newdata` marked. `treatment_effect_curve()` returns the plotted curve for custom figures.

```{r}
plot_treatment_effect(example_patients[2, ], scale = "ard")
```

```{r}
curve <- treatment_effect_curve("rmst")
head(curve)
```

## Model specification

The model is stored as aggregate parameters in a JSON file installed with the package. No participant-level data are included.

```{r}
mhspc_model()
```

The specification is at `system.file("extdata", "model_spec.json", package = "mhspcarpi")`.
